 Judgment

The PSI of Pulakeshi Nagar police station, Bengaluru has filed the charge sheet against the accused No. 1 & 2 alleging commission of the offence punishable under sections 498(A), 506 R/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code.

2. BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :-
It is the case of the complainant that, on 14/04/2008 she got married with accused No. 1 and thereafter the accused No. 1 by not providing food to the complainant subjected her to cruelty by harassing her physically and mentally and also abused her, assaulted her.

It is further alleged that, the accused No. 1 was having relationship with another girl and in the said matter on 08/03/2013 at 10.00 am, when CW1 enquired accused No. 1, to which the accused No. 1 assaulted CW1 with hands,
accused No. 2 abused CW1 in foul language and dragged her out from the house.
It is further alleged that, CW3 to 5 talked with the accused persons.
It is further alleged that, when CW1 went to the house of the accused persons to bring her clothes,
accused
No. 1 and 2 picked up a quarrel with CW1 and threatened CW1 with dire consequences.
Based on the typed complaint lodged by CW1, CW7 has registered the case against accused No. 1 & 2 in P.S. Crime No.411/2014 for the offence punishable under section 506, 34, 498A of IPC.

Investigating Officer/CW7 investigated the matter and after completion of investigation submitted final report against the accused No. 1 & 2 for the offence punishable under section 498(A), 506 R/w. 34 of IPC.
3.
Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the offence punishable U/s. 498(A), 506 R/w. 34 of IPC against the accused No. 1 & 2 and registered the criminal case against them.
The presence of Accused No. 1 & 2 have been secured and were released on bail.
Copies of the final report and its enclosures were furnished to them in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charge.
Accordingly charges framed against the accused No. 1 to 2 for the offences punishable U/s. 498(A), 506 R/w. 34 of IPC.
They pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

4. In order to prove the guilt of the accused No. 1 to 2, the prosecution has examined four witnesses out of 7 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as PW1 to 4 and relied upon four documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.4 and closed its side.

Thereafter, the accused No. 1 & 2 were examined as provided Deepa vs Bala Murali And Others on 20 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74056015/
2 U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C by explaining incriminating evidence appearing against them.

sentences.text: The accused No. 1 & 2 have denied the same and they have not produced any of either oral or documentary evidence.
5. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.

6. The points that arise for my consideration are;
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on 14/04/2008 CW1 got married with accused No. 1 and thereafter the accused No. 1 by not providing food to the complainant subjected her to cruelty by harassing her physically and mentally and also was having relationship with another girl and in the said matter on 08/03/2013 at 10.00 am, when CW1 enquired accused No. 1, to which the accused No. 1 assaulted CW1 with hands, accused No. 2 in furtherance of common intention, abused CW1 in foul language and dragged her out from the house,
CW3 to 5 talked with the accused persons and thereby accused No. 1 & 2 committed an offence punishable U/s.498(A) R/w. 34 of IPC?
2.Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, during the said period, when CW1 went to the house of the accused persons to bring her clothes, accused No. 1 and 2 in furtherance of common intention, picked up a quarrel with CW1 and threatened CW1 with dire consequences and thereby accused No. 1 & 2 committed an offence punishable U/s.506 R/w. 34 of IPC?
3. What order or sentence ?
7. My findings on the above points are as under :
 Point Nos.1 & 2 : In the Negative.

Point No.3 : As per the final order  for the following ;
 REASONS 8.
Points No.1 & 2:-
As these two points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repetition of facts & evidence.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has to establish that,
accused No.1 and 2 in furtherance of common intention, subjected CW1 to cruelty by harassing her both physically and mentally and also abused her, assaulted CW1 with hands, accused No. 2 abused CW1 in foul language and dragged her out from the house and threatened CW1 with dire consequence.
9. The prosecution in order to prove the guilt of the accused No. 1 & 2 has examined the complainant / CW1 as PW1, the relative of the CW1 i.e., CW3 as PW2, mother of the complainant i.e., CW5 as PW3, wherein, initially they have supported the case of the prosecution.
During their cross examination they have deposed that, they are not having any interest to prosecute the matter.

PW1 and PW3 were re- examined by the learned APP wherein they have denied that as they have Deepa vs Bala Murali And Others on 20 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74056015/
3 compromised the matter they are deposing falsely.

sentences.text: 10. The prosecution has examined the IO i.e., CW7 as PW4, wherein, he deposed regarding investigation being carried out by him from the inception of registering the case, forwarding FIR and drawing spot mahazar, recording the statement of witnesses and filing of final report.
11. I have carefully examined the ocular evidence of PW1 to 3 in comparison with the materials on record.
PW1 and 3 have categorically deposed that, they are not having any interest to prosecuting the matter.
Merely relying on the evidence of IO it would not be sufficient to conclude that, the accused No. 1 and 2 have committed the offence as alleged.
The evidence on record both by way of oral and documentary evidence are not sufficient to conclude that the accused persons have committed the crime as alleged.
Therefore, the prosecution has failed to establish its guilt beyond all reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused No.1 & 2 and hence, the Point No.1 & 2 are answered in the "Negative".
12. Point No.3:-

In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER  Acting under section 248(1) of  Cr.P.C. the accused No. 1 & 2 are  acquitted of the offence punishable under sections 498(A), 506 R/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code.
The Bail bonds of accused No. 1 & 2 shall be in force for the period of 6 months and thereafter it shall be canceled without further orders.
